description: This is a Swift source file implementing the discovery of wide-area gateways via DNS and Tailscale status parsing. It defines data structures, constants, and functions for discovering gateways over a wide area network using DNS-SD and Tailscale status.

classes.name: TailscaleStatus
classes.description: A decodable struct representing the JSON status output from Tailscale, including self node and peer nodes.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Discovers WideAreaGatewayBeacons within a specified timeout using DNS-based discovery and Tailscale status.

methods.name: collectTailnetIPv4s
methods.description: Extracts and filters IPv4 addresses associated with the tailnet from Tailscale status JSON.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to run the Tailscale CLI to retrieve JSON status if available.

methods.name: loadWideAreaPtrRecords
methods.description: Performs DNS PTR record lookup for gateway services within the designated domain.

methods.name: runDig
methods.description: Helper method to execute the 'dig' command with provided arguments and timeout.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a process with given path, arguments, and timeout, returning standard output.

methods.name: parseSrv
methods.description: Parses SRV DNS record output to extract host and port.

methods.name: parseTxtTokens
methods.description: Parses TXT DNS record output into tokens, unescaping DNS-specific escape sequences.

methods.name: decodeDnsSdEscapes
methods.description: Decodes escape sequences within DNS-SD TXT records.

methods.name: mapTxt
methods.description: Converts an array of TXT tokens into a dictionary with keys and values.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Converts a String into an Int, if possible.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Determines if an IP address belongs to the tailnet IPv4 range.
